annotations.title: Find live jobs near a place

description: Search US jobs that are live right now on employers' own careers sites (re-read on a schedule, retired within about 36 hours of leaving). Give what (title or keywords) and where (City, ST or ZIP), or remote_only. Returns up to 25 jobs with posted pay, what each posting asks for (education, licences, years), distance, when it was last confirmed, the employer's own apply link, and a job_id for the whole posting. Only the filters given are applied; the "asks" are listed, never used to drop a job.

min_pay.description: Minimum pay: annual, or hourly if under 300. Jobs that do not post pay are kept, listed last.

what.description: Job title or keywords, e.g. "registered nurse", "forklift"

name: search_live_jobs
